from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial metrics for a single company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company (e.g., 'Shenzhen Property Development (Group) Co., Ltd.')")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code if available (e.g., '000011')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Report period in YYYY-MM format (e.g., '2025-01')")
    ending_monetary_funds: float | None = Field(description="Ending Monetary Funds (期末货币资金) in CNY")
    cash_paid_for_fixed_assets: float | None = Field(description="Cash paid for acquisition, construction of fixed assets, intangible assets and other long-term assets in CNY")
    net_cash_flow_operating: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities (经营活动产生的现金流量净额) in CNY")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: list[CompanyFinancialReport]
